description: This file defines the SugarWidgetFieldURL class, a widget class for rendering URL fields as clickable links in the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM application. It extends SugarWidgetFieldVarchar and overrides the displayList method to output the URL as an HTML anchor tag.

classes.name: SugarWidgetFieldURL
classes.description: A widget class for rendering URL fields as clickable links in list views, extending SugarWidgetFieldVarchar.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Returns the URL value as an HTML anchor tag linking to the URL, for display in list views.
